create_entity_statements: CREATE ENTITY Category (category_id INT PRIMARY KEY, category_name VARCHAR, parent INT);
CREATE ENTITY Product (product_id INT PRIMARY KEY, sku VARCHAR, product_name VARCHAR, base_price INT, is_active INT, quantity INT, mv_attributes VARCHAR[]) ;
CREATE ENTITY PhysicalProduct (dimensions VARCHAR) subclass of Product(total);
CREATE ENTITY DigitalProduct (delivery_type VARCHAR) subclass of Product(total);
CREATE ENTITY Electronics (warranty_months INT) subclass of PhysicalProduct;
CREATE ENTITY Computer (cpu VARCHAR, ram_gb INT) subclass of Electronics;
CREATE ENTITY Desktop (form_factor VARCHAR) subclass of Computer;
CREATE ENTITY Laptop (battery_wh INT) subclass of Computer;
CREATE ENTITY Tablet (screen_size_in INT) subclass of Electronics;
CREATE ENTITY Smartwatch (band_size VARCHAR) subclass of Electronics;
CREATE ENTITY Camera (sensor_mp INT) subclass of Electronics;
CREATE ENTITY Phone (carrier_lock VARCHAR) subclass of Electronics;
CREATE ENTITY Accessory (accessory_type VARCHAR) subclass of Electronics;
CREATE ENTITY Appliance (energy_rating VARCHAR) subclass of PhysicalProduct;
CREATE ENTITY KitchenAppliance (warranty_years INT) subclass of Appliance;
CREATE ENTITY Apparel (size_system VARCHAR) subclass of PhysicalProduct;
CREATE ENTITY Clothing (material VARCHAR) subclass of Apparel;
CREATE ENTITY MenClothing (fit_type_men VARCHAR) subclass of Clothing;
CREATE ENTITY WomenClothing (fit_type_women VARCHAR) subclass of Clothing;
CREATE ENTITY Footwear (sole_material VARCHAR) subclass of Apparel;
CREATE ENTITY Media (format VARCHAR) subclass of DigitalProduct;
CREATE ENTITY Software (license_type VARCHAR) subclass of DigitalProduct;
CREATE ENTITY User (user_id INT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR, password_hash VARCHAR, mv_user VARCHAR[]);
CREATE ENTITY Customer (loyalty_tier VARCHAR, contact_no VARCHAR[]) subclass of User;
CREATE ENTITY PrimeCustomer (renewal_date VARCHAR, subscription_addons VARCHAR[]) subclass of Customer;
CREATE ENTITY BusinessCustomer (company_name VARCHAR) subclass of Customer;
CREATE ENTITY Employee (employee_no VARCHAR) subclass of User;
CREATE WEAK ENTITY ProductImage (image_id INT discriminator, url VARCHAR, alt_text VARCHAR, sort_order INT) DEPENDS ON Product;
CREATE WEAK ENTITY ProductVariant (variant_id INT discriminator, price_override INT, barcode VARCHAR, is_active_variant INT) DEPENDS ON Product;
CREATE WEAK ENTITY PriceHistory (price_id INT discriminator, starts_at VARCHAR, ends_at VARCHAR, price INT) DEPENDS ON Product;
CREATE ENTITY Tag (tag_id INT PRIMARY KEY, tag_name VARCHAR);
CREATE WEAK ENTITY Address (address_id INT discriminator, kind VARCHAR, line1 VARCHAR, city VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, country VARCHAR, postal_code VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON Customer;
CREATE WEAK ENTITY PaymentMethod (payment_method_id INT discriminator, brand VARCHAR, last4 VARCHAR, exp_month INT, exp_year INT, is_default VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON Customer;
CREATE WEAK ENTITY Cart (cart_id INT discriminator, updated_at VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON Customer;
CREATE WEAK ENTITY Wishlist (wishlist_id INT discriminator, wishlist_name VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON Customer;
CREATE WEAK ENTITY Review (review_id INT discriminator, rating INT, title VARCHAR, body VARCHAR, created_at VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON Customer;
CREATE WEAK ENTITY BrowsingSession (session_id INT discriminator, started_at VARCHAR, device VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON User;
CREATE ENTITY CustOrder (custorder_id INT PRIMARY KEY, placed_at VARCHAR, status VARCHAR);
CREATE WEAK ENTITY Shipment (shipment_id INT discriminator, carrier VARCHAR, tracking_no VARCHAR, shipped_at VARCHAR, delivered_at VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON CustOrder;
CREATE ENTITY Promotion (promo_id INT PRIMARY KEY, promo_name VARCHAR, starts_at VARCHAR, ends_at VARCHAR, discount_type VARCHAR, discount_value VARCHAR);
CREATE WEAK ENTITY Coupon (coupon_code INT discriminator, max_uses INT, per_user_limit INT) DEPENDS ON Promotion;
CREATE ENTITY Warehouse (warehouse_id INT PRIMARY KEY, warehouse_name VARCHAR, region VARCHAR);
CREATE WEAK ENTITY WarehouseBin (bin_id INT discriminator, code VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON Warehouse;
CREATE ENTITY Supplier (supplier_id INT PRIMARY KEY, supplier_name VARCHAR);
CREATE WEAK ENTITY SupplierContact (contact_id INT discriminator, email VARCHAR, phone VARCHAR) DEPENDS ON Supplier;
CREATE ENTITY PurchaseOrder (purchaseorder_id INT PRIMARY KEY, created_at VARCHAR, status VARCHAR);
CREATE ENTITY CourierPartner (courierpartner_id INT PRIMARY KEY, carrier_code VARCHAR, webhook_url VARCHAR);
create_relationship_statements: CREATE RELATIONSHIP category_products () between Category(one total) and Product(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP product_tags () between Product(many total) and Tag(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP bundle_components () between Product(product_id many total) and Product(bundle_product_id many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP bought_together () between Product(product_id many total) and Product(bought_together_product_id many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP cart_contains () between Cart(many total) and Product(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP wishlist_contains () between Wishlist(many total) and Product(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP reviews () between Product(one total) and Review(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP customer_orders () between Customer(one total) and CustOrder(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP order_items () between CustOrder(many total) and Product(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP payment_order () between PaymentMethod(one total) and CustOrder(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP order_returns () between CustOrder(many total) and Product(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP order_coupons () between CustOrder(one total) and Coupon(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP stock () between Product(many total) and WarehouseBin(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP supplier_products () between Supplier(many total) and Product(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP supplier_pos () between Supplier(one total) and PurchaseOrder(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP po_items () between PurchaseOrder(many total) and Product(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP courier_shipments () between CourierPartner(one total) and Shipment(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP bundle_phones () between Phone(phone_id many total) and Phone(bundle_phone_id many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP bundled_phone_accessory () between Phone(many total) and Accessory(many total);
CREATE RELATIONSHIP software_downloads () between Software(many total) and Customer(many total);
